name: Brian Reader (Hatton Garden ringleader, 2015; illustrated representation)
depiction: Illustrated representation, not a likeness. A generic older man in his seventies (white hair, a flat cap, a workman's hi-vis jacket or a plain dark coat); no attempt is made at his real face and no feature is exaggerated. Never glamorised or caricatured; no weapon, no violence. Every shot he appears in is tagged 'ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS'.
rules: Shown only arriving, at the drilled wall on the first night, and walking away. No weapon, no violence, no victims; never shown with the loot. Tagged 'ILLUSTRATION · NOT A LIKENESS'.
